Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> nfr;
Description:
std::uint8_t optinal member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined nfr (nominal frame
rate) 4 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype AAF.
The value range for event shall be:
0x00...0x0F : valid
0x10...0xFF : not used
For transmission, if format is set to a value which represents a AES3 stream data encapsulation
the middleware shall set value of bit_depth to the configured value, if it is not provided by the
application.
Visibility:
protected
